name: cloud-superapp-mcp
description: MCP server — the Android constellation's on-device debug API (libs:devtools AppDebugServer) reached over ssh

mcp.description: Discovers every constellation app serving AppDebugServer on the phone (127.0.0.1:38080,38090-38139) and proxies its routes: logcat, crashes, docs, fleet wake, and any app-registered route via superapp_call.
